evidence: Traffic crossing the SW3-R1 trunk intermittently fails for untagged management traffic.
SW3 show interfaces trunk output indicates Gi0/2 native vlan 99.
R1 show interfaces Gi0/0 trunk output indicates Native VLAN: 1.
root_cause: A native VLAN mismatch exists between SW3 (configured with native VLAN 99 on Gi0/2) and R1 (configured with native VLAN 1 on Gi0/0), causing untagged management traffic crossing the SW3-R1 trunk to fail intermittently.
verification: Run show interfaces trunk on both SW3 and R1 to confirm that the native VLAN matches on both ends of the link.
Manually test untagged management traffic connectivity across the SW3-R1 trunk after the approved change.
fix_steps: Verify the native VLAN configuration on SW3 interface Gi0/2 and R1 interface Gi0/0 using show interfaces trunk.
Configure the same native VLAN on both ends of the SW3-R1 trunk to resolve the mismatch.
Verify that untagged management traffic can now successfully cross the SW3-R1 trunk without intermittent failures.

rule_checker_findings.evidence: Connected trunk endpoints show different native VLAN values.
rule_checker_findings.recommended_action: Configure the same native VLAN on both ends of the trunk.
